description: This file defines the ProductImage class, a JPA entity representing product images within an e-commerce system. It contains fields such as image paths, flags for default images, image type, cropping options, and relationships to product and description entities.

classes.name: ProductImage
classes.description: Represents a product's image with metadata, description list, and database mappings.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Returns the file path or name of the product image.

methods.name: setProductImage
methods.description: Sets the file path or name of the product image.

methods.name: isDefaultImage
methods.description: Checks if this image is the default for the product.

methods.name: setDefaultImage
methods.description: Sets whether this image is the default.

methods.name: isImageCrop
methods.description: Checks if the image is set to crop.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the image.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the image.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates this image with a Product.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of image descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of image descriptions.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Gets the image data as an InputStream.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image data from an InputStream.
